The bariatric Extra-Wide Two-Button Heavy Duty Walker with Dual 5” Wheels features easy-to-use push-button mechanisms that may be operated by the fingers, the palm, or the side of one’s hand. The front cross braces near the top allow users to maintain a full stride. ## Features

- Quick Fold Design 

Fold the walker flat in seconds for easy storage and transport. Its compact, travel-ready build fits perfectly in car trunks or closets, helping users stay mobile wherever life takes them.
- Reinforced Weight Support 

Crafted with a heavy-duty steel frame, this bariatric walker supports up to 600 lbs with confidence. Ideal for users seeking stability and strength, it ensures secure movement at home or on the go.
- Adjustable Height For Better Posture 

With 10 height settings, the walker customizes to your exact needs for comfort and posture support. It easily locks into place, making it ideal for users from 4’11” to 6’6” who want a tailored walking experience.
- Smooth Rolling Wheels 

Dual front wheels glide effortlessly across both indoor and outdoor surfaces. Combined with non-slip rear tips, they deliver stability, control, and safety for confident walking on any terrain.
- Ergonomic Comfort Frame 

Built for everyday use, the walker’s ergonomic frame and soft-grip handles reduce strain and increase comfort. Perfect for recovery or long-term mobility support, it helps users move naturally and securely.

## FAQ

#### How much weight can this walker support?

The Vive Bariatric Walker is built with a reinforced steel frame that safely supports up to 600 pounds. It’s designed for heavy-duty use while maintaining smooth mobility and dependable stability.

#### Is the walker easy to fold and store?

Yes! The walker features a quick-folding design that collapses flat in just seconds. It easily fits in car trunks, closets, or beside the bed, perfect for use at home, during travel, or for recovery.

#### What is the walker’s height range?

This adjustable walker offers 10 secure height settings to fit users from 4’11” to 6’6”. It locks firmly in place for a custom ergonomic fit that promotes better posture and comfort while walking.

#### Does the walker come with wheels?

Yes, the walker includes dual front wheels for smoother, more controlled movement. The rear legs feature non-slip rubber tips for added traction and safety across indoor and outdoor surfaces.

#### Can the walker be used both indoors and outdoors?

Absolutely. The smooth-rolling dual wheels glide easily over most indoor floors and outdoor pavements. Its stable base and slip-resistant tips provide dependable control wherever you go.

#### How heavy is the walker itself?

Despite its strong steel construction, the walker remains lightweight and easy to handle. It’s designed for effortless lifting, folding, and everyday use without adding strain.

#### Does it come assembled?

The walker arrives partially assembled and takes just a few minutes to set up—no tools required. Clear instructions are included to help you get moving right away.

#### Is the walker comfortable for taller users?

Yes, the adjustable height and extended frame design make it comfortable for users up to 6’6” tall. It provides more walking space and promotes natural movement without hunching or leaning.

#### What warranty does Vive offer?

The Vive Bariatric Walker includes a 2-year warranty on the frame, a 90-day warranty on the wheels, and a 30-day warranty on the tips. You can purchase with complete confidence knowing you’re covered.

#### Who is this walker best suited for?

This heavy-duty folding walker is ideal for individuals who need extra support for mobility, recovery, or balance. Whether you’re regaining strength after surgery or maintaining daily independence, it provides the stability and comfort you can trust.

results.title: Medline Bariatric Rollator Walker Review: An Excellent Indoor-Outdoor Bariatric Walker
results.text:
Skip to content

SeniorsMobility is reader-supported. When you buy through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Learn more

 By jwilder

Bariatric rollators are an important part of rehabilitation, recovery, and daily life for many people. They can help keep you safe, active, and healthy despite your health issues.

The Medline bariatric rollator is one such model that does it all. It’s perfect for indoor and outdoor use, has one of the highest weight capacities around, and provides great comfort for all users!

Read our Medline Bariatric Rollator Walker review to learn more about this model and learn if it’s right for you!

Review of: Medline Bariatric Rollator Walker

Please click image for more info

What We Like:

- Excellent for Bariatric use
- Higher seat position
- Wide seat
- All terrain wheels
- Handlebar adjustment

What We Don’t Like:

- Heavy
- Slightly too wide

Our Conclusion: Bariatric rollator walkers are a very helpful device for recovery, rehabilitation, and mobility. The Medline Bariatric Rollator is one of the best on the market; it has an extremely high weight capacity, high seat position, and other features that make it perfect for many types of users. 

## Features of Medline Bariatric Rollator Walker

### 500 Pound Weight Capacity

The numbers say it all: this rollator has one of the highest weight capacities on the market, making it perfect for bariatric treatment. The vast majority of bariatric patients will have no issues trusting this rollator walker to support them. Whether you’re walking and need the rollator to support some weight to make things easier or need to take rest breaks to catch your breath, this rollator will be there for you!

That “500-pound weight capacity” applies to every part of the rollator, not just the steel frame. This means the seat, backrest, and wheels won’t wear out on you in a short time. The main purpose of this walker is to serve the needs of bariatric patients, and every piece of it works toward that goal.

### Easy Assembly

Many rollators, especially ones that are ordered online, come in pieces and feel like they require an engineering degree to put together. This rollator, however, will be out of the box and fully assembled in a matter of minutes!

When you’re shopping for a rollator walker, the last thing you want to have to deal with is the headache of putting it together. Medline’s Bariatric Rollator prevents you from dealing with that headache and gets you on your feet and moving safely in speedy fashion!

### Large Wheels

Wheels, no matter the size, make living with a walker much easier and less draining– but small wheels only work well indoors. Eight-inch wheels, like the ones on this model, mean that you can go just about anywhere you’d like without trouble. These large, soft wheels do a great job of absorbing impact, helping you keep your balance on rougher terrain. Whether it’s grass, dirt, or gravel, this rollator can handle it all!

Large wheels also make for more comfortable walking even indoors; they roll smoother than 4 or 6-inch wheels, making the rollator easier to push. They also add height to the rollator without adding weight. Making a rollator tall enough with small wheels means the designers have to use more steel, which is harder to maneuver. Having large wheels makes a rollator much more convenient and versatile!

### High Seat

This is a rather minor feature that can have some impactful benefits. The seat height on this rollator walker is 22 inches, which is just a bit higher than your standard rollator. People who weigh more know the knee pain that comes with sitting on a seat that’s too low; it puts a ton of pressure on the knees to bend down that far.

It’s helpful to have a seat that doesn’t require you to put that kind of pressure on your knees. This helps you recover and rehabilitate from injuries and operations faster and with less pain. After all, a medical device should be going out of its way to prevent pain, should it not?

### Other Features

- Easy Folding: This rollator, like many others, can fold up nearly flat to fit into your car or stay out of the way while sitting. It’s a common feature, but a welcome one- especially for a larger rollator!
- Light-Grip Brakes: The brakes on your rollator are one area where you don’t want a lot of strength. At least, that is, in terms of how much strength it takes to engage them. The brakes on this model only need a light squeeze to bring you to a full stop!
- Underseat Storage: Another common yet handy feature. There is a spacious zip-up storage bag under the seat that can hold your belongings while you’re out and about. Very convenient!

## Specifications of Medline Bariatric Rollator Walker

- Inside Walker Width: 23.5″
- Latex-Free? Yes
- Overall Width: 29 Inches
- Product Weight: 25 lb
- Walker Height Range: 31.5″-37.5″
- Weight Capacity: 500 lb
- Wheel Size: 8 Inches

## Video Overview of Medline Bariatric Rollator Walker

## Pros and Cons of Medline Bariatric Rollator Walker

PROS

- Excellent for Bariatric Use: Some rollators are bariatric in name only; that is, they are advertised as bariatric rollator walkers, but cannot actually do the job. This rollator has the weight capacity, width, and seat height that make it perfect for its job!
- Higher Seat Position: The seat, at 22 inches, is high enough to prevent knee pain when sitting and standing for most people.
- Wide Seat: The seat is also wider than most rollators, both on the actual cushion and the width between the handlebars. This allows larger users to sit comfortably without feeling like they are “perched” on a small seat.
- All-Terrain Wheels: Many bariatric rollators are intended solely for indoor use. This model has spongy 8-inch wheels that will be able to handle many different surfaces, from gravel to grass and everything in between.
- Handlebar Adjustment: The handlebars can adjust to any height between 31.5 and 37.5 inches, making it great for tall and short users alike. Having a rollator that’s not the right height can cause back pain and posture issues, so it’s nice to have a wide range of height options to choose from.

CONS

- Heavy: This is a rather unavoidable problem, but a problem nonetheless. It weighs more than twenty pounds, which can make it pretty hard to push and maneuver, especially around corners.
- Slightly Too Wide: At 29 inches wide, this rollator is one of the widest on the market. This is problematic when trying to fit through narrow doors; some doors in older homes are only 26 inches wide.
- Basic Design: It’s a strong, wide rollator and not much more. If you’re looking for extra features like cupholders and additional storage, you’ll have to purchase them separately.

## Who is the Medline Bariatric Rollator Walker Best For?

No surprises here: this rollator walker is perfect for heavier users, up to 500 pounds. It’s built with strength in mind and can fit just about anyone on it. While it may not be loaded out with all sorts of luxury features, it isn’t meant to be a luxury model.

The Medline Bariatric Rollator is great for long term use, but it’s more ideal for short term/indoor applications. If you’re looking for a heavy-duty rollator for rehabilitation or recovery, this is a wonderful option! It has everything you need, but it’s still uncomplicated and easy to use. Walking is a great recovery aid after bariatric surgery but can be risky if balance issues or fatigue arise. Rollators provide great balance, so this heavy-duty rollator should be at the top of your post-op recovery list!

If you want a heavy-duty rollator for long-term or permanent use, this can also be a fine choice. You’ll just want to look into getting some rollator accessories, such as cup holders, additional storage, and the like, so that it’ll have all the extra features that a long-term rollator should.  

## Other Heavy-Duty Rollators You Might Like

Want to keep your options open, or see what else is out there? Check out these three heavy-duty bariatric rollator walkers. They have different strengths and features you might find desirable!

### 1. Beyour Walker Heavy Duty Upright Rollator

Upright rollator walkers like this one are a great option for people who need a little more assistance. You can rest your weight more easily with the arm supports. This provides extra stability and comfort for those who need it, and helps your posture!

It still has the large wheels and 500-pound weight capacity that a bariatric rollator needs; if you’d prefer the added support of an upright walker, this is a great heavy-duty option!

### **** 2. Healthline Bariatric Rollator

This rollator has a lower weight capacity (only 400 pounds), but it’s still strong enough for most people. The biggest advantage this model has over others is its extra-wide seat. The 18-inch wide and 13-inch deep seat is bigger than just about any rollator on the market.

If the width of a rollator you’ve previously owned has left you feeling uncomfortable, like you’re balancing on the edge, this could be a great solution for you!

### 3. Nova Star Heavy Duty Bariatric Rollator

This 450-pound capacity rollator has one great feature that sets it apart: the seat height is fully adjustable. It has large wheels for outdoor use and a wide seat that any bariatric rollator should have, but that adjustable seat is hard to match.

If you’re taller or shorter than average, being able to change the height of your seat will make standing and sitting an easier and less painful task!

## Conclusion: Medline Bariatric Rollator

If you’re on the lookout for a bariatric rollator and you want something that will keep you safe and comfortable for years, this Medline rollator will do exactly that!

Bariatric Folding Walker

The Bariatric Folding Walker is engineered to deliver exceptional strength, stability, and comfort for larger users who need dependable mobility support. A two-button folding mechanism allows the walker to fold easily for navigating narrow doorways and tight spaces, making it practical for both home use and travel. The reinforced frame design, featuring a front cross brace and dual side braces, enhances durability and long-term reliability.

A great walker can help you maintain your independence and get around more easily. But with scores to choose from, some topping $500, it can be a challenge to figure out the best one for your needs.
